decisions.reason: The additional reference expands the general reference basis but does not necessarily change the hook standard, viral style, or three-second attention window.
The reference video's successful Meta performance does not change the existing winning-creative objective or target CPL.
The source adds reference material for review but does not change the required testimonial content source or presentation format.
The additional successful reference is not identified as a source of product benefits or claims, so the existing benefit source remains unchanged.
The source does not provide or change any target-audience characteristics.
Adding a reference video does not change the required video count, duration, aspect ratios, or output package.
The new reference does not alter the freelancer's full-service production responsibility or required supplied elements.
The reference-video decision is unrelated to the deferred landing-page and tracking audit and does not resume or modify it.
The source does not specify that the additional reference changes the established UGC visual style or realism criteria.
